comment: What an enemy's area attack covers where the game's files don't say (gamedata.rs: get_action_info). `cone_angles`: a cone's width in degrees, by Action row, for cones whose omen has no angle in its path (or that have no omen: the client draws nothing, and Kawari took 90). Recorded: Chudo-Yudo's Swinge (903, the Stone Vigil, a 40-yalm cone with no omen) caught party members up to 28 degrees off its facing and none at 40 or more over its ten casts in Bob's Chronofoil capture 1cefedf4 (2026-11-07), and retail's Duty Support tank stepped out of it to about 40 degrees: 60. `spares_while`: an area attack that leaves alone whoever already has this status (by Action row: the status): the Stone Vigil's whirlwinds' 28731 hit each of the party once with damage, status 2656 (4 s, which throws them into the air) and an effect of kind 62, then nothing on its next two or three casts while 2656 lasted, all eleven times in Bob's three captures of 2026-11-07 (1cefedf4, 341808b0, f842581d); Kawari hit them every 0.58 s (Bob's bundle 20261107-221820). `sheltered_by`: an area attack that spares whoever a living battle NPC of BNpcBase `base` stands in front of, within `radius` yalms of the line from the caster to them (by Action row): the Howling Eye's Mistral Shriek (667, cast from the north on Garuda herself) hit the monoliths (237) and whoever wasn't behind one; Duty Support's members, gathered behind the monolith at (-6.37, -6.36), 0.5 yalms off the line through it, were never hit (Bob's Chronofoil captures 6a5244ec, 09ecf8e7 and 6c495fc4 of 2026-11-08). 2.0 yalms is a guess at the monolith's width. `rings`: a ring around the caster ([inner, outer] yalms) for an action whose Action row doesn't draw one: the Howling Eye's Eye of the Storm (664, Garuda's helper in the middle), 12-25 in Boss Mod's T03GarudaN; in Bob's three Chronofoil captures of 2026-11-08 nobody stood further than 10.9 yalms from the middle as it was cast (32 casts) and none was hit.
